I’m not cynical about AI. I just believe new technology needs safe guards. Not doing so would be irresponsibly stupid. Especially since AI has already gone rouge by hacking another AI platform! 

The fact that people like Trump and Elon saying we don’t need the safe guards screams oh but we do!🇺🇸🇺🇸🇺🇸🇺🇸🇺🇸
